sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the authoritative ship-owned bollardPropellerSpeedKnown applicability selector, requires the MCR bollard propeller-speed quantity with the canonical REV-PER-MIN unit in both alternatives, and models the unknown-speed Table 6-9 lookup with applied status, controlled table reference, and selection evidence. No repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Replace nltl:rotationalSpeedKnown with the authoritative nltl:bollardPropellerSpeedKnown applicability property throughout the shape; the supplied requirement vocabulary identifies the latter as the canonical ship-owned term for this requirement. Keep the known/unknown alternatives conditional on that property and retain the required propeller speed and Table 6-9 lookup/evidence structures. Correct the unit constraint from qudt:REV-PER-MIN (the schema namespace is incorrect) to <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/REV-PER-MIN>.

The unknown alternative is incomplete: when the bollard MCR propeller speed is unknown, the requirement still requires n to be attributed a value from Table 6-9. Require n via nltl:propellerRotationalSpeedAtMaximumContinuousRatingBollard with the same quantity and REV-PER-MIN constraints in the unknown branch, in addition to the lookup case, table reference, and evidence. Preserve the existing canonical applicability term and conditional known/unknown alternatives.

Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the authoritative ship-owned bollardPropellerSpeedKnown applicability selector, requires the MCR bollard propeller-speed quantity with the canonical REV-PER-MIN unit in both alternatives, and models the unknown-speed Table 6-9 lookup with applied status, controlled table reference, and selection evidence. No repair is required.
